name: shared-home
$tagsComment: Tier 3 of docs/business-apps/architecture.md: the home engine, which draws an app's home.json (app-definition-v2.md, section 10). An engine is shared code, so it carries scope:shared as well as scope:engine, and imports only shared code.

test.$inputsComment: nx.json's test inputs, plus the proposal whose home example a spec draws: without it an edit to the example would replay a cached pass.
